Xpring + Blockchain @ Berkeley Hackathon on October 2-3 in SF

Community
event

Sep 5, 2019 #1

Ripple’s Xpring team and Blockchain at Berkeley are hosting an Interoperability Hackathon at UC Berkeley on October 2-3 to promote the open-source development of Interledger and the XRP Ledger.

The event is open to the general public and will have $15,000 in prizes, as well as lots of free food and drink!

If you’re interested, you can apply to attend here: https://xpring-hack.devfolio.co/
